entities.summary: Azra "Akilah" Kohen is a Turkish writer. After releasing her first novel, Fi, under the name Akilah, she started to release her subsequent novels, Çi and Pi under the name Azra Kohen. She later published novels Aeden in 2017 and Gör Beni in 2019.
